senses.sense_definition: A person whose job is to correct, change, or improve written texts and documents.

examples.text: She works as an <w>editor</w> for a large book publishing company.

target_lang_translations.fr: Le <w>correcteur</w> a corrigé les fautes de grammaire dans le manuscrit avant qu'il ne soit imprimé.
target_lang_translations.it: Il <w>redattore</w> ha corretto gli errori grammaticali nel manoscritto prima che venisse stampato.
